rows.note: Use 影響 as the all-purpose noun for both the power to affect someone or something and the person or thing exerting that influence.

example.english: This TV drama has a big influence on teenagers.
example.traditional: 呢套劇對青少年嘅影響好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 deoi3 cing1 siu3 nin4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for having an effect on or swaying someone or something.

example.english: This film can influence how I see family.
example.traditional: 呢套戲影響咗我對家庭嘅睇法。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 ngo5 deoi3 gaa1 ting4 ge3 tai2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when the influence decisively sways a decision, result, or person's judgment.

example.english: This matter will influence the election result.
example.traditional: 呢件事會左右選舉結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 wui5 zo2 jau6 syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this for the persuade or induce slice when someone is convinced to agree or act.

example.english: My friend finally managed to influence me to join the trip.
example.traditional: 我個朋友終於說服我一齊去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 pang4 jau5 zung1 jyu1 syut3 fuk6 ngo5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
